nodes.long_description:
VRC-NEXUS is a standalone companion for VRChat, built for Quest.

• Discover & equip public avatars, and manage your favourites in custom sections
• Import your VRChat website favourites ("inf favourites")
• Friends, worlds, groups and notifications at a glance
• OSC controls: chatbox, live avatar-parameter sliders (set height, hue, emission…), and quick actions (mute, jump)
• Visual OSC scripting: drag-free code blocks with loops, ramps and a one-tap rainbow — including bounce/ping-pong cycles
• Sign in with your own VRChat account (password never stored; only a local session cookie)
• In-app auto-updates

Unofficial third-party tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by VRChat Inc.
nodes.short_description: Your VRChat companion on Quest — browse & equip avatars, manage favourites, friends, worlds, plus OSC chatbox, avatar controls & visual scripting.

nodes.change_log:
:rocket: VRC-NEXUS Quest — What's New

:musical_note: Now-Playing / Media — a whole new setup

- :new: Choose your music source — new Source dropdown, and the methods are mutually exclusive (so a rate-limited Last.fm can't block the others):
  - Notification access (headset media) — the default, and imo the best method.
  - Last.fm — any device, free.
  - Spotify (Premium) — re-added; your own Spotify app via OAuth.
  - :boom: Discord (Spotify) — see below, it's a big one.
- Small characters for the media time played (superscript ⁰¹² / subscript ₀₁₂).
- Toggleable small "ᴮʸ" — show now-playing as [song] ᴮʸ [author].
- Hide the author to save characters (shows just the song name).

:bar_chart: Progress bar upgrades

- Times now sit on each side of the bar when shown (1:23 ███░ 3:45) — minimises characters.
- Bar defaults to size 9 to save room.
- Put the bar on its own separate line if you prefer.

:clock1: Chatbox formatting

- Small numbers (and letters) for current time and session uptime too — the whole thing shrinks so it matches (e.g. ᵁᵖ ³ʰ ²⁰ᵐ).

:white_sun_rain_cloud: Weather

- Defaults to just the temperature — and you can now hide your location.
- Individual toggles: location, peak temps (high & low), and condition (rainy/cloudy/etc).
- Much more reliable city search (two-pass lookup — handles misspellings & small towns; still testing very complex locations).

:earth_africa: Community Hub

- Search by name, author, or tag.
- Publish under your own name (remembered) instead of Anonymous.
- Massively improved reliability — you should never see the HTTP 403 error again.

:shield: Reliability & performance

- "Run in background" prompt on first open so the chatbox/OSC keep updating while you're in VRChat.
- Last.fm hardened for scale — adaptive polling + back-off, and it only polls when Last.fm is actually your selected source (stops the shared key getting rate-limited).

---
:boom: MASSIVE ADDITION — NEW MEDIA METHOD: Discord (Spotify)

I noticed one of our competitors had this, so I built our own version — introducing the Discord method.

All you need is Spotify connected to your Discord (Settings → Connections → Spotify). Once that's done:
1. Join the VRC-NEXUS Discord (one-tap Join button in-app) so our bot can see your status,
2. Paste your Discord user ID into the app (completely safe, dw)

VRC-NEXUS Quest — What's New

� Now-playing music is way easier to set up

- New first-run walkthrough — the first time you open the Chatbox tab, a step-by-step guide pops up and walks you through getting music working, with a picture of each screen:
  a. Toggle media integration — turn on Now playing (device) (with a one-tap button that does it for you).
  b. Grant notification access — opens the correct Quest screen; just toggle VRC-NEXUS on.
  c. Done — play any media on your Quest and it shows in your chatbox automatically.
  d. Optional — want music from your phone/PC instead? Connect Last.fm (free, no login).
- Back / Next / Skip navigation with progress dots, and it only shows once.
- Replay anytime with the new � Setup guide button in the now-playing options.

� Working "Notification access" button (no Developer Mode / ADB)

VRC-NEXUS Quest — Changelog since 0.4.8

� New features

- � Nexus Statistics tab — live community presence (using now, peak today, all-time) plus your personal stats (favourites, sections, avatars worn, worlds visited, presets, days as a member) and Community Hub totals.
- World / User / Avatar popups — tap anything to open a detailed card: mutual friends, instance names with hosting group + region + 18+ tags, self-invite/join, worn-avatar save, wear/favourite/copy.
- Settings — themes (Nexus, Midnight, Ember, Emerald, Rose, Slate, Light), custom accent colour, compact mode, reduce-motion, blur toggle, and a chosen launch tab.
- Full Backup & Restore — export/import your favourites, sections, chatbox setup, presets, and settings (auth never included).

� Chatbox & Music

- Removed Spotify; added Last.fm as a free nupdating while minimized, with synced lyrics+ progress.
- Multiple integrations per line (e.g. time + date on one line).
- Customizable progress bars for now-playing.
- Chatbox presets/profiles — save, switch, and share complete setups (fixed the bug where clicking a preset did nothing; community imports now bring all settings).
- Fixed the mic toggle always showing "on".

� OSC

- Hue/emission params now auto-detect across avatar changes — the Rainbow and other set_hue/set_emission scripts keep working on your new avatar without tapping Rescan, even while you're in VRChat.

� Social & Instance tools

- Instance Tools group — Players list + dedicated Invite Tools.
- Group moderation — give/remove roles from
- World favourites — add/remove worlds.
- Favourites section filter — tap a section to show only its avatars.
- Community share packs — share and import packs like the PC app, including sharing specific sections.
- Fixed the player roster reading no players from the logs.

� Interface

- Left vertical sidebar with tidy, collapsible dropdown groups.
- Merged Cache + Dev into one (Dev Mode no lg just works).
- Customizable Home Quick Access — add your own shortcuts instead of fixed ones.
- Help tab with common how-tos and a Join Discord button.
- Cleaner, less cluttered layouts throughout.

� Reliability & performance

- Low-memory crash fixes — thumbnails lazy-load and release as you scroll, so big favourites lists no longer run theapp out of memory; added memory-pressure handling.
- Last.fm hardened for scale — adaptive polling + automatic back-off, reliable even with thousands of users.
- Community Hub fixed — presets, share packs, and scripts now load reliably.
- Faster, cached Nexus presence that scales to large user counts.
